name: MTDC Resort Amboli
why_special: Maharashtra Tourism's hill resort at Amboli ghat — A/C cottages with valley views over the Sahyadris, in-house restaurant. The default monsoon-tourism (Jun–Sep) and Hiranyakeshi Falls base.

name: Whistling Woods Resort Amboli
why_special: Private mid-range resort at Amboli ghat — cottage rooms with Sahyadri views, multi-cuisine restaurant. The polished alternative to MTDC for monsoon waterfall hunters.
